question: I'm following along with this biscuit recipe. Please guide me through each step as it happens.

Now pour in one cup and two tablespoons of buttermilk. Stir with a spatula just until a shaggy dough begins to form.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface. Knead it gently, then roll it out and fold it over itself a few times to create those flaky layers.
Roll the dough out one last time and use a glass or round cutter to press out your biscuit shapes.
Place the biscuits on a baking sheet and bake at 275°F for 18 to 20 minutes until they've doubled in size and are golden brown.
Once they're out of the oven, brush the tops generously with melted butter while they're still hot.
